// # ICoordinate interface
//
// The marker interface for every point-like type: a position in some space, as
// opposed to the displacements of `vectors.types.plato`. The implementing
// types are declared in `points.types.plato`, `points.types.plato`, and
// `points.types.plato`; the derived bodies live in
// `numeric-structures.library.plato`.

// A position in some coordinate space
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinate_system). Marker interface for all
// point-like types.
interface ICoordinate

{ }
